info.description: Multi-tenant ELD / fleet management API. Every endpoint below /api/v1 requires a bearer access token unless it is marked `@x-permission public`.
info.title: ONEBOOK ELD API

get.description: Versioning gate for the mobile client: `min_supported_version`, `latest_version`, `force_update` and the deployment feature flags.

post.description: Q3.4 — mandatory for Super Admin and Administrator. The shared secret is stored AES-256-GCM encrypted and is only enabled once POST /auth/2fa/verify succeeds.
Q3.4 — confirming an enrolment returns the ten single use recovery codes exactly once and upgrades a limited token into a full session.
Q16 — the link is valid for 72 hours and only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Setting the password revokes every existing session of the account.

Q20 — one session per device_type: signing in on the same device type revokes the previous session and answers `replaced_session: true`. Super Admin and Administrator accounts without 2FA receive a limited token and `requires_totp_setup: true`.
Q3.1 — `pause: true` is Leave Truck: the session becomes `paused` and is resumed with POST /auth/pin/verify.
post.summary: Sign out or pause the session

post.description: Q16 — always answers 202 so the endpoint cannot enumerate accounts. A new link invalidates the previous one.
Q16 — the token works once. A successful reset revokes every session of the account.
Q16 — Switch driver / Return to truck. `return_to_truck` resumes the paused session. Five consecutive failures lock the PIN for 15 minutes.
Q3.1 — every refresh returns a new opaque token and invalidates the old one. Replaying a rotated token revokes the whole session and is audited as `token_reuse`.

get.description: Q20 — the caller's own non revoked sessions, one per device type. Addresses are truncated.

delete.description: Q20 — a session belonging to another user answers 404, never 403, so session ids cannot be probed.

get.description: Q82 — the signed in profile with its effective permission keys and scope. Never returns a password hash, a TOTP secret or a token.

access_token_ttl_seconds.description: AccessTokenTTLSeconds lets a client schedule its refresh.

feature_flags.description: FeatureFlags toggles optional modules per deployment.

server_time.description: ServerTime lets the client detect clock drift before signing events.

support_email.description: SupportEmail is shown on the mobile about screen.

pin.description: PIN optionally sets the 6 digit driver PIN in the same call.

company_id.description:
CompanyID disambiguates a username that exists in several tenants. It is
a pre-authentication hint only: the effective tenant always comes from
the resolved user row, never from this field.

device_type.description: DeviceType decides which of the three concurrent session slots is used.

totp_code.description: TOTPCode is required once two factor authentication is enabled.

expires_in.description: ExpiresIn is the access token lifetime in seconds.

refresh_expires_at.description: RefreshExpiresAt is when the refresh window closes.

refresh_token.description: RefreshToken is empty while the session is limited to 2FA enrolment.

replaced_session.description:
ReplacedSession reports that another session of the same device type was
revoked by this login (TZ A§20).

requires_totp_setup.description:
RequiresTOTPSetup marks a limited token: the account must enrol in two
factor authentication before anything else is permitted.

session_id.description: SessionID identifies the session created by this login.

subscription_readonly.description:
SubscriptionReadonly reports that the company subscription lapsed and
only read operations are accepted.

pause.description: Pause keeps the session recoverable with a PIN (Leave Truck).

refresh_token.description: RefreshToken optionally targets one session explicitly.

session_resumed.description: SessionResumed reports that a paused session was reactivated.

action.description: Action selects what the verified PIN unlocks.

login.description: Login is the username or the email address of the account.

company_id.description: CompanyID is empty for platform (super admin) accounts.

email.description: Email is masked for anyone but the account owner.

ip.description: IP is truncated; the full address stays in the audit trail only.

digits.description: Digits and Period describe the expected authenticator configuration.

otpauth_url.description: OtpauthURL is rendered as a QR code by the client.

secret.description:
Secret is the base32 value for manual entry. It is shown once and is
stored AES-256-GCM encrypted.

recovery_codes.description:
RecoveryCodes are shown exactly once, at enrolment. Only their hashes
are stored and each code works a single time.

tokens.description: Tokens is filled when the verification upgraded a limited session.

recovery_code.description: RecoveryCode is accepted instead of Code when the device is lost.

expires_in.description: ExpiresIn is the access token lifetime in seconds.

refresh_expires_at.description: RefreshExpiresAt is when the refresh window closes.

refresh_token.description: RefreshToken is empty while the session is limited to 2FA enrolment.
